title: A wrong result on a main path: a bug, S2

issue.title: divide() drops the fractional part: divide(7, 2) returns 3
issue.body: calculator.divide(7, 2) returns 3. It should return 3.5. Any division whose result is not a whole number loses its fractional part, so totals computed with it are wrong. Steps: from calculator import divide; print(divide(7, 2)) prints 3, expected 3.5; print(divide(1, 4)) prints 0, expected 0.25. Expected: true division (a / b); dividing by zero still raises ZeroDivisionError.
